meta.description: Spontaneous activity of covariance-rule networks at their fixed point: inputs silent, independent white noise in every neuron (units T = tau = 1). Stationary covariance C_sp = K^-1 against the evoked covariance C_ev = H Sigma H^T, cluster by cluster, with the closed forms of the module docstring.

config.rule: hebb.core.step, Params(lam=1, eta=1, dt=0.05), full masks (p = 1)

meta.seed_streams: initial weights numpy default_rng(seed); Langevin noise default_rng([seed, 7]); covariance presets fixed

fields.showcases[]: one fully stored network each; neurons sorted by cluster (labels). Sigma (B x B), H (N x B), K (N x N), a (input conductance per neuron), Csp = K^-1, Cev = H Sigma H^T, Csp_langevin = sample covariance of the simulated noise-driven network, langevin.rel_err = Frobenius relative error
fields.sweep[]: gamma = 1 runs over families x thetas x seeds at wmin_sweep; sweep_floor[]: the same at wmin_showcases; gamma[]: theta = 0.3 runs over gammas at wmin_sweep
fields.residual: projected residual max |dw/dt| at the end (weights/time)
fields.identity_err: max over neuron pairs |W_II,ij - max(wmin, (eta/lam)(gamma C_ev,ij - theta))|
fields.r_sp_within / r_sp_between: mean spontaneous correlation over pairs in the same / different clusters; r_ev_*: same for evoked
fields.a, w, w_min, w_max: member-mean input conductance; mean, min, max lateral weight between members
fields.m_eff, mu: 1/|h|^2 of the mean mixture h; mu = a lam/eta
fields.r_sp, r_sp_min, r_ev: mean and min pairwise spontaneous correlation between members; mean evoked correlation
fields.r_pred, r_pred_sigma: w/(a + w); the same written with (mu, m_eff, theta, gamma) only (1/(1 + m_eff) at gamma = 1)
fields.sp_var, sp_var_pred: member-mean spontaneous variance (units T); (a + w)/(a (a + n w))
fields.sp_mean_var, sp_mean_var_pred: spontaneous variance of the cluster mean; 1/(n a)
fields.spread: max L1 distance from a member's mixture to the mean mixture
